title: ニュージーランドTにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is it—the New Zealand Trophy. With this graded mile race, Yamanin Zephyr is about to take her first step down the path of the Mile Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She enters the paddock to countless cheers. Hearing the spectators, she's struck by the strangeness of the sensation in her ears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though the voices are loud and piercing, she doesn't mind them at all. With this peculiar realization, she readies herself for the race.
